changes: Implemented the static overlap engine in new core/parallel-decomposition-overlap.ts: computeWriteSet (allowedModify union allowedCreate), globsOverlap (tier-1 literal intersection + tier-2 conservative shared-dir-prefix nesting + NARROW/BROAD + broadSide), validateWriteSetGrammar (rejects bare/mid-path/empty-dir wildcards and .. segments), classifyBroadness, with robust segment-filter path canonicalization. + smoke (44 assertions).
usage: Story 2 (gate verdict) imports globsOverlap/computeWriteSet from core/parallel-decomposition-overlap.js to compute scope overlap between stories; the §4.3 gate hard-blocks only tier-1 literal pairs, tier-2 is advisory.
expectedOutcome: tsc compiles; the smoke prints 44 assertions passed and exits 0; globsOverlap conservatively flags real prefix collisions without under-flagging and never over-flags genuine siblings.
actualTranscript: lattice validate PASS; smoke 44/44. Genuine Claude+Codex dual-host review over 6 rounds — full-3x2.
outcomeDiff: 10 findings resolved. Codex (host 2) caught 6 real correctness bugs Claude missed (children shared-prefix under-flag, empty-dir wildcards, single-segment literals, redundant segments, repeated leading ./, terminal ..). After fixes expected==actual.
limitations: The engine lives in a sidecar; the frozen contract parallel-decomposition.ts still exports NotImplemented stubs — re-export reconciliation is Story 5 by design (Story 1 cannot edit the frozen contract). Pattern-vs-pattern subsumption beyond the literal|dir/*|dir/** grammar is intentionally not implemented (conservative two-tier per spec).
pitfalls: globsOverlap MAY over-flag in tier-2 (advisory) but never under-flags a literal collision; the gate must hard-block only on tier-1 literal-vs-literal pairs. Write-set entries must be POSIX relative paths in the literal|dir/*|dir/** grammar; .. and malformed wildcards are rejected, not canonicalized.
